entries.title: Psalms 122:1
segments: A Song of degrees; of David. I was glad when they said to me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 122:2
segments: Our feet shall stand within your gates, O Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 122:3
segments: Jerusalem is built like a city that [is] all joined together as one;

entries.title: Psalms 122:4
segments: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, to the testimony of Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 122:5
segments: For there were set the thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

entries.title: Psalms 122:6
segments: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; those who love you shall be blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 122:7
segments: Peace [be] within your walls, blessings within your palaces.

entries.title: Psalms 122:8
segments: For my brothers and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace [be] within you.

entries.title: Psalms 122:9
segments: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your good.
